text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yay! We're the blooming generation classmates!
Sparkling friends walking the same Tiara path together~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, can I hear it again?!
Heart-san and Messiah-san's feelings about the Tiara route...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, honestly Craft, you're always
talking about the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I have spoken of it before, but...
Very well, it is of great importance, so allow me to say it once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft, Daring Heart, and Air Messiah.
Three classmates treading the Tiara route were deep in conversation.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My reason is simple.
That's right...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I want to be at the center of the most glamorous stage!
That is what truly befits a Queen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's been that way ever since I was in the USA!
I always want to be right at the center of everyone's circle!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In academics, sports, charm—
as the number one horse girl in everything!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In this country's horse girl world, that would be...
the Queen of the Triple Tiara, wouldn't it?
Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Aiming to be the queen you admire so much!
So that's your reason, Heart-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Longing to be queen. I can certainly understand
that feeling. However...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I do not want you to forget that there are those
who harbor earnest feelings far different from simple yearning.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
My mother challenged every race of the Triple Tiara.
Yet in every single one, she suffered a bitter defeat...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Watching those recordings over and over again...
I've always wished to clear away that regret someday.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
It is not 'I want to win,' but 'I must win.'
My reason is—the 'inevitability of blood.'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san...
Your feelings toward the Tiara races
are so profound and heavy, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And why is Craft aiming for it?
What's your reason?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Well, for me... I don't really have any
particular grand reason, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I've just... always watched them!
Ever since I was a kid, gazing with admiring eyes
at the horse girls who won the Tiara route GⅠs!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu-san, who won the first Triple Tiara
and made everything look so sparkly and brilliant.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Flower-san, who seized the cherry blossoms despite being small and lovely.
Air Groove-san, who was hailed as even tougher than Derby horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And after them, Dober-san and Sweep-san too.
Not a single one of them...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
can be compared, nor can any of them be forgotten.
Every single race, all of them...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
They are what I yearn for! If I can stand on that stage,
I'd do anything!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't have a grand reason,
the Tiara races are everything to me!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Craft-san... I see.
To hold such deep passion for all those races...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the one most crazy about the Tiara's history
is Craft after all♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I just love the sparkle of the Tiara.
I love it so much! So today too...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
Running like that, just from pure love alone...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I even find myself feeling envious
of such purity.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san, Heart-san!
Come on, don't just watch. Let's do something together
toward our Triple Tiara goals!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Something together... I suppose.
I don't mind doing something, but what exactly...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Trainer over there,
what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In order to shine on the Tiara stage,
what should we be doing right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I think. What Rhein Kraft and the others
should do right now is...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Accumulating race strategies... Indeed.
Then Craft-san, please come with me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Preparing for races is not something
done solely on the training grounds.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Coach
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone. Today we will conduct
an advanced lecture on course positioning.

text_block_list.name: Tracen Academy Coach
text_block_list.text:
What are everyone's thoughts regarding
the curve radius of Kyoto Racecourse?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
C-Curve radius~?
Isn't this basically math~?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Do you really have to study stuff like this
just to aim for the Triple Tiara~?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Craft-san.
What you have seen until now is merely the surface.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Behind admiration—lies what's under the surface.
My mother told me that countless times.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Do you possess the resolve to face
what lies behind the scenes as well?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san...
I see. So all of the senior Tiara horse girls
have gone through this too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Then I'll do my best! I'll give it everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind the glamorous Tiara route lies steady, diligent study.
Rhein Kraft quietly burned with renewed determination.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Wow! A Queen Bee dance!
Yes, that's exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Craft! I'll teach you a USA-style dance
fit for a true queen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Hey! Yeah!
Craft, like this! More like this!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
If you don't give it your all, the cheerleader spot
will be snatched by another girl♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Mmmwah♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Heart-san...!
Not only are you amazing at dancing,
but your charm and appeal are... incredible!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So this is American dancing...
In that case, I won't lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Like this, maybe!
Someday, I'll definitely...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: become a cheerleadeeeer!!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Craft! But becoming a cheerleader
isn't what we're aiming for, is it? Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft got so swept up in the excitement
that she ended up straying far from her original goal.
